author: Brodigan
description:
This has been a long time coming.

When I started Change My Mind, it was never meant to dunk on students. The students are the ones who have been failed by their institutions.

That’s why I challenged professors across the country to formal debates and offered a charitable contribution to the organization of their choice.

I gave them a standing offer: you pick the topic, time, place, and moderator. Just show up and try to Change My Mind.

We had attempted to do this at a college in April. The local Marxists did everything they could to stop it.

Someone new is willing to step up. Harvard Professor Randall Kennedy.

Yes, HARVARD.

Boch Center Shubert Theatre in Boston.

Monday, September 28.

6:00 PM.

If you’re near the area, admission is free —
title: So I’m debating a Harvard Professor…
